metadata.description: Root-architect execution protocol for Claude Code: a root session keeps the plan, Git and the ledger while schema-declared isolated workers implement and review.

plugins.name: root-architect-execution
plugins.description: Run an implementation plan from a root session that never writes product code. Three worker roles — implementer, plan-compliance validator, quality validator — are declared once as JSON manifests carrying model tier, reasoning strength, tool grant and read-only status, then generated into per-host agent files with honest disclosures for whatever the host cannot enforce. Two PreToolUse hooks enforce what the prose only asked for: root cannot edit a path it has delegated, and workers cannot touch Git.
